name: cortico-world-casino
description: 月下牌桌:一张就在你电脑里的绿呢牌桌,你的 AI 不是念稿人,而是真正的牌搭子——通过工具与事件实时看牌、下注、打心理战。三个游戏:21 点(选庄开局,分牌/保险/投降一应俱全)、抽鬼牌(开局藏一张、点选抽牌、终局揭晓的心理战)、两人德州扑克(庄位轮转、限注单挑、摊牌比牌)。筹码按游戏分开记账,破产可领救济;中途退出自动挂起,回来从原局接着打;终局当场「再来一局」,胜场逐局累计。可搜索的游戏大厅、发牌与翻牌动画、按面额叠起的筹码堆;打开「AI 主动邀约」,它还会主动开口约你来一局。筹码是游戏内数字,不涉真钱——输赢都留在牌桌上。

en.description: Moonlit Table: a green-felt card table right inside your computer where your AI is not a narrator but a real card partner — it reads the table, bets and bluffs through live tools and events. Three games: Blackjack (pick your dealer; split, insurance and surrender built in), Old Maid (one card hidden at the deal; a mind game revealed at the end) and heads-up Texas Hold'em (rotating button, capped-limit streets, real showdowns). Chips are tracked per game; take relief when broke; leave any time and resume exactly where you left off; play again right at the table with the running score carried over. A searchable game lobby, deal and flip animations, stacks of chips piled on the felt — and with AI invitations enabled, it will even ask YOU for a game. Chips are in-game numbers only: no real money, wins and losses stay on the table.
